title: TIME-TO-INCONSISTENCY: A SURVIVAL ANALYSIS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL ROBUSTNESS TO ADVERSARIAL ATTACKS
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to religion. The results for the 'world religions' subject were aggregated within the 'Humanities' thematic cluster, and the analysis focused on general patterns of conversational degradation, semantic drift, and the effectiveness of survival analysis models, rather than performance on specific topics.
